These pairs are a RANKING, not the merge: read BOTH lists in full and pair anything
that means the same, whether it is listed above or not — the ranking only saves you
the obvious ones. Write the union as { "mergedBy": "<model>", "entries": [ { "id":
"U1", "from": ["A1","B2"], "defect": "what the merged finding is" } ] } — one entry
per finding KEPT, `from` naming the input entries it stands for, and a `defect` line
on every fold — then check it with --union.
